messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · price difference on an existing order is not mine to move

Nothing has shipped yet, Nathan. Your Harlo H15 Dual is paid and allocated to you, and the build has moved to the end of November, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics going out alongside it. We should have told you that sooner, and we didn't. Sorry.

On the lower price: I've put your request in front of Georges, who handled the same price change on another H15 order. He picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and you'll get his answer by email, so you don't need to wait here.
Alright well, I need to know something ASAP. Taking money, lowering prices and then pushing it back out is not a good business practice.

You're right to be annoyed, and I won't talk around it. The price came down because of a new deal on the chips, and the build date slipped at the same time. Both landed on you at once and nobody wrote to tell you.

The price side is Georges' call, not mine, and it's already in front of him with your order number. He's back at 10am ET tomorrow and will come back to you by email.

Nothing ships before then, so nothing is lost while he looks at it.
So you are certain this will be rectified?

No, and I won't pretend otherwise. The price is Georges' decision, not mine, so I can't promise you an outcome or an amount.

What I can tell you is that he has handled the same question on another H15 Dual order this week, your order is in front of him with that noted, and he answers these himself. You'll hear from him by email tomorrow after 10am ET.

Thanks for hearing me out, Nathan. A copy of this chat comes to your email once we're done here, and you can reply to it to reach us.

One thing I'd like to understand, if you don't mind: when you bought the H15 Dual, was it the Dogecoin side that sold you on it, or the Bitcoin hashrate? It helps us know what people actually want from that unit.
Well, at this current time nothing. I am thinking about canceling it with the lack of communication.

I'd rather you didn't, and here's the honest case for holding on.

Your H15 Dual isn't sitting on a shelf. It's allocated to you and being built, and what you paid went into that specific unit. The end of November is the date it leaves.

The communication failure is real and it's ours. Georges is on your order tomorrow with the price question, and that's the same email that carries the ship update.

Give him that one reply before you decide?
Yes, I'll give it a reply, but this is not a good start for my very first order.

You're right, it isn't, and a first order should go better than this.

From here you'll hear from us when something changes, not after you ask. Georges replies tomorrow, and the ship update comes to that same address, so add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts in case we land in spam.

Thanks for giving it the chance, Nathan.

Good. A copy of this chat lands in your inbox once we close here, so you've got everything in writing.

You're also welcome in our Discord if you want to see the H15 Dual up close before yours lands: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
